rationale: Y directly surfaces findings that mirror the ground-truth thread: its #4 (level-2 contract dropped from merge gate to weekly-only, mock test only proves route propagation not the engine contract) matches Gaohan123's P2 concern almost exactly and proposes a concrete fix, and its #9 independently verifies and resolves the P1 question about NotImplementedError→501 mapping via the upstream handler. X investigates the same underlying facts in its 'Validated' scan section but never elevates them into reviewer-facing findings, so it misses credit for the concerns that actually mattered in the human review. Both reviews substantially overlap on other solid, well-grounded findings (num_cards=1 on a 2-device fixture, core_model/H100 marker mismatch, dropped TP=2 diffusion coverage, red AMD CI gate), keeping precision high for both, but Y adds a high-value, deeply-verified new bug (vacuous VRAM assertions from measuring the wrong process) and consistently pairs every finding with a concrete 'Change:' fix and severity ranking, giving it an edge in actionability over X's denser, more repetitive evidence-dump format (X also duplicates its top finding across two entries).
